items.evidence: Deleted the unreferenced runtime_bootstrap._int helper after repository reference search; referenced admin-token helpers remain and now read Flask config.
API limit alias is an active compatibility route with explicit Deprecation/Sunset headers.
Authentication route configuration reads use current_app instead of direct environment access.
Provider modules are registered explicit infrastructure profiles; deleting them would remove active runtime adapters.
Generated shared, miniprogram and Markdown API contracts are consumed by compatibility checks and clients.
Therapeutic case creation fields and required idempotency are generated from an explicit route override.
Task registry generators remain referenced by required verification commands; no unreferenced helper was proven safe to delete.

principle: Only redundancy with reference evidence is deleted. No such safe deletion was established in F24.
